title: Reserve bounded persistence shutdown budgets from shared deadline
business_goal: Ensure each persisted observation worker receives a bounded shutdown attempt within the shared drain deadline.
current_behavior: The optional pre-drain loop may consume the shared deadline before sequential worker shutdown APIs run; observed shutdown artifact recorded zero budgets for tick, depth, and runtime workers.
expected_behavior: Bound pre-drain waiting and allocate remaining shared time across workers; report incomplete shutdown as failed/partial when work remains.
acceptance_criteria: pre-drain wait is bounded below shared deadline
each persistence shutdown API receives a positive computed budget while time remains
remaining work or unjoined workers keep shutdown status FAILED/PARTIAL
tests cover fast return and full allotted-slice consumption
no broker API, order action, or LIVE enablement is introduced
safety_constraints: no runtime restart or live operation
architecture_impact: Changes only shared-deadline allocation in the existing read-only observation lifecycle; no new persistence mechanism.
qa_attack_plan: consume entire tick budget and ensure depth/runtime still receive computed budgets
retain pending accounting and alive workers and ensure final state remains FAILED/PARTIAL
verify no state claims worker failure root cause or WAL fix
uat_criteria: review evidence claim limits; live runtime validation is not claimed
release_gates: retain UNVERIFIED claim and no live readiness assertion
rollback_plan: Revert the isolated shared-deadline allocation change and focused tests.

evidence_standard.applicability_reason: Runtime lifecycle behavior changes require traceable source, correctness, adversarial, and independent evidence.

claims.statement: The shutdown lifecycle bounds its optional pre-drain wait and apportions remaining deadline among persistence shutdown calls; focused tests cover normal and full-slice timing while incomplete drains remain FAILED/PARTIAL.

assumptions.statement: The observed artifact corresponds to the 2026-10-13 supervised run described in the handoff.

claims.limitation: AI role labels are unauthenticated; full lifecycle, independent UAT, exact-head CI, worker failure cause, WAL checkpoint cause, and live runtime outcome remain unverified.
